_meta.source: CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1, Sheet 9 of 26, Case No. 17 'TYPICAL APPLICATION - LANE CLOSURE, 2-LANE HIGHWAY, AT CURVE' (issued 07/31/2019; sheet revisions through 01/14/26: 'REMOVED G20-10/11', 01/20/23 'Replaced R52-6(b) with R2-10(11), Updated G20-11, Add Drum/VerticalPanelSymbol')
_meta.edition_note: 2026-07-01 re-issue verified editorial-only per CDOT issuance memo; values unchanged.
_meta.verified_by: Claude (Fable 5 vision extraction at 300 dpi), June 10 2026; re-verified June 11 2026 with fresh independent crops at 300/500 dpi (PR 2 Phase A) - series, gaps, taper bracket, warning note, and regulatory cluster confirmed
_meta.verification_changelog: PR 2 Phase A re-verification: all Phase 1 values confirmed correct; three omissions added: (1) opposing-flagger standoff '200' TO 300'' from work-area end, (2) downstream taper '100' MAX.' annotation, (3) the 500'/500' exit chain dimensions for R2-11 and the restoration R2-1
_meta.purpose: extraction record for CDOT's only direct 2-lane flagger lane-closure typical. Curve-specialized; routing DEFERRED for V1 (see match_rules.md) - extracted because it is the closest CDOT analog to TA-10 and documents the CDOT advance series and the short-taper warning.
_meta.extraction_caveat: Case 17 shares Sheet 9 with Cases 15/16 and the diagram is drawn around a horizontal curve; some dimension anchors are harder to read than Case 42's straight-road strip. Where Case 42 (same sign family, straight road) is crisper, its chain is recorded as the dimensioned reference.

case_17.title: Lane Closure, 2-Lane Highway, at Curve

scenario.geometry_trigger: work zone at or near a horizontal curve
scenario.closure_type: lane (one lane closed, alternating one-way traffic)
scenario.control: flagger each end (flagger-station symbols on diagram)

case_17.advance_spacing_markers: C / B / A letter-coded gaps between the three signs (resolved by the Sheet 9 KEY TO ADVANCE SIGNING DISTANCES); '0.5B 0.5B' tick pair dimensions the upstream regulatory cluster (R2-10 BEGIN DOUBLE FINES ZONE and the G20-5P WORK ZONE + R2-1(XX) SPEED LIMIT assembly) relative to the warning series

upstream_regulatory_cluster.label: BEGIN DOUBLE FINES ZONE
annotations: star (see FINES DOUBLE SIGNING NOTES, Sheet 12)

downstream_sequence.label: SPEED LIMIT XX (posted-speed restoration)
annotations: diamond (NOT optional if the posted speed limit in the work zone is reduced)

flagger_to_taper.position_on_diagram: between the A-position W20-7 / flagger-station region and the one-lane two-way taper into the curve

downstream_taper.position: device run guiding traffic back to the original lane past the work area; the 500 ft gap to R2-11 is measured from its end
downstream_taper.added: PR 2 Phase A re-verification (500-dpi end-region crop)

opposing_flagger_standoff.spans: from the work-area end to the opposing-direction flagger station (dimension ticks read at 500 dpi: work-space end -> flagger symbol)
opposing_flagger_standoff.interpretation: CDOT dimensions the opposing flagger 200-300 ft clear of the work area - more standoff than MUTCD Fig. 6P-10 implies (MUTCD's far-end '50 to 100 ft' dimension spans work-space end -> end of the channelizing-device run, not the flagger position). CDOT supplements MUTCD here; Case 42 reuses the same 200-300 ft as the pilot-car turnaround space.

case_17.taper_warning_note_verbatim: THIS TAPER MUST BE SHORT ENOUGH TO NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR A TRANSITION.
case_17.taper_interpretation: the flagger-end taper is the short one-lane, two-way traffic taper (50-100 ft per MUTCD 6B.08 para 14), NOT a full merging taper L; the note exists precisely because a long taper misleads drivers into treating the closure as a merge
other_diagram_features: SIGN SEQUENCE IS (the same) FOR OPPOSITE (direction) note at the diagram edge - series mirrored for the opposing approach
arrow board / mobile attenuator symbol shown near the work area (legend: optional devices per triangle marker rules)
buffer space not dimensioned; CDOT Sheet 2 General Note 24 makes buffer optional/engineer-determined
case_specific_notes: Case 17 is curve-specialized: MUTCD TA-10 note 6 guidance (extend buffer so the two-way taper lands before the curve, preserving flagger sight distance) is the underlying principle the case illustrates.

Case 17 does NOT show R4-1 DO NOT PASS or W3-4 BE PREPARED TO STOP; both appear in Case 42 (pilot car). The CDOT minimum series at a curve is the three-sign MUTCD series plus the fines/speed regulatory cluster.
The 01/14/26 sheet revision 'REMOVED G20-10/11' postdates the 2019 issue - the extracted diagram reflects the revised state (no G20-10/G20-11 BEGIN/END markers).
case_17.routing_decision: DEFERRED for V1. Conestruct's form does not capture horizontal-curve geometry, and the case adds no sign the basic TA-10 + CDOT overlay does not already carry. Revisit if/when curve geometry becomes an input (V1.1+).
